ai.s: Adds a V3 POST endpoint to create floor plan halls for an event, with an optional hall image by upload or URL.

ai.wy: Part of the Public API V3 migration, splitting create and update into clear REST operations.
ai.oc: POST /api/v3/events/{eventId}/floorplan/halls specified with a unique hall name and image options; updates move to a separate PUT.

ai.s: Builds an AI Agenda Builder agent that combines an attendee's schedule with recommended sessions into a clash-free recommended agenda.

ai.s: Builds an AI Search agent that brings the AI Search service into the chatbot, with filtering, recommendations and actions.
